comments.text: Tuning in from Vietnam! (It's 10:01 PM here). The philosophical breakdown of the Barong and Rangda dance completely changed my perspective. In Western storytelling, good always has to destroy evil, but the Balinese concept of "Rwa Bhineda"—recognizing that opposite forces must exist together to maintain cosmic balance [11:02]—is such a mature, peaceful way to look at the world. The scriptwriting captured that nuance perfectly. Thank you for making documentaries with real depth! ⚖👏
